description: openEMS: the owner's LVDS_100R edge-coupled pair (C41) on L1 over L2 of the default stackup, w 0.11 s 0.2 trapezoid with JLCPCB mask, 10 mm between the reference planes, four 50 ohm lumped ports 3 mm beyond them

structure.frame: x along the lines, y across (pair centre y = 0, P at +y), z up; z = 0 is the top face of L2 (the PEC floor); the lines run from x = -8 to 8, the domain to |x| = 9.6 with the PML in the outer 8 cells

stackup.note: one box over the laminate and one box around each trace

stackup.etch: trapezoid, base 0.11 on the laminate, top 0.09222 (offset 0.00889 per side)

openems.interface: Python 3.14 wheels of the release, venv C:\Users\Jonat\opt\openEMS-venv
openems.engine: default (multithreaded), material averaging on, lossless here

mesh.pml: 8-cell PML inside the domain on every open side
mesh.notes: y: cells <= 0.015 over the traces (lines on the base and top edges and the mask faces), graded 1.3 to 0.15, mirror-symmetric about y = 0; z: 4 cells in the prepreg, lines on every copper and mask face, graded to 0.15; x: 0.1 uniform, symmetric

excitation.source: openEMS LumpedPort 1 (R 50 ohm, soft E source in its edges) at x = -8

ports.name: P1
ports.kind: lumped port R 50 ohm at x = -8, y = 0.155; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)

ports.name: N1
ports.kind: lumped port R 50 ohm at x = -8, y = -0.155; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)

ports.name: P2
ports.kind: lumped port R 50 ohm at x = 8, y = 0.155; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)

ports.name: N2
ports.kind: lumped port R 50 ohm at x = 8, y = -0.155; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)

sParameters.referencePlanes: the ports' x above (10 mm apart, no de-embedding)
sParameters.how: one excitation (P1); S_ij = p[i xor j] by the mirror symmetries y -> -y and x -> -x (common.fit_s), which removes the end ports' mismatch; stored: the first column

mixedMode.how: Sdd11 = S11 - S21, Sdd21 = S31 - S41, Scc11 = S11 + S21, Scc21 = S31 + S41 (pairs (P1, N1) and (P2, N2), zRef 100 and 25 ohm)

tdr.time: round trip, 0 = 50 % of the edge at the reference plane

line.how: modal sums of the probe planes (both ends averaged): differential V_P - V_N, (I_P - I_N)/2; common (V_P + V_N)/2, I_P + I_N; Z = sqrt(E dE/(H dH)), eeff from beta; and eeff from the phase of Sdd21 and Scc21 over the 10 mm

sanity.note: the 2D solver (lines.ts) on the same trapezoid, mask and stackup (facts-cases.md C41: 103.36 +- 0.15, Zcm 30.91); bars |dz| <= 3 %

provenance.postProcessedAgain: from the same run's probe files (--post): S, lines and sanity re-made by the scripts named
